Text:
We poured everything into it. Three years, every penny, every ounce of effort.

And it hurt deeply to let it go.

Part 2 on Saturday.

She changed my life.

As a mom, being outside is how she refills. It started with a podcast — 1,000 Hours Outside — and then it was a friendship she never saw coming.

When that friend moved away, it hurt. But before she left, she introduced her to something.

An outdoor adventure school. Five hours in nature. All the parents, gathered together.

And what they found there...

Part 4 tomorrow.

What they found there — standing in that mountain school, surrounded by parents and kids just figuring it out together — was a gap.

A gap in knowledge. A gap in confidence. A gap in community for mamas who want to get outside with their kids and have no idea where to start.

She was there not that long ago. And now she wants to help fill it. She'll share as she learns.

Welcome. She is so glad you're here.
